intro: Ethiopia's economy has grown fast, built on farming, coffee and a big airline.

chapters.title: Coffee
text: Coffee comes from Ethiopia; legend says a goatherd named Kaldi noticed his goats dancing after eating the berries. It is Africa's biggest coffee producer.

chapters.title: Growth
text: Ethiopian Airlines is Africa's largest airline. The giant GERD dam on the Blue Nile produces electricity, though Egypt and Sudan worry about the river's flow.

cardGroups.title: Made in Ethiopia
cardGroups.intro: Some of the things Ethiopia makes and sells to the world.
